reach_towns.label: Transport-matched reference · food unconstrained

items.label: Catchment tint: fraction of civilian request supported
Circles: allocated resident scenario; dark centre: feasible cohort

reach_towns.note: Scenario: finite local cereal supports requested civilians and a resident institutional cohort in ONE repeating food budget. Only feasible affiliated cohorts emit two-way seasonal reach. Same candidates and transport in every case; no population-to-power multiplier. Proposed sites inherit painted-claim hypotheses; marked evidence takes precedence. Missing sources or local grain support do not prove empty land or lost sovereignty. Other staples, livestock food, maritime grain imports, water volumes and labour are not yet integrated. See the selected-site ledger and methods.
reach_towns.caption: Local cereal-dependent allocation; reference requests are assumptions, not measured city sizes.
